verdict.rationale: Datadog documents in-product AI over user data in two narrow forms: natural-language querying of infrastructure and telemetry data, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluators that flag issues in a user's LLM application spans. Neither is shown to be a general AI assistant that proactively generates insights or recommendations across monitoring data; Bits AI appears only as an agent whose usage is tracked. Missing for 10: documented general AI-generated insights/suggestions across telemetry (e.g. root-cause or anomaly explanations), detail on the natural-language query feature, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Query infrastructure resources and telemetry data using natural language or DDSQL syntax with support for tags as table columns.
Custom LLM-as-a-judge evaluators use an LLM to judge the performance of another LLM.
Flags the presence of sensitive or regulated information in model inputs or outputs
